About.title: What is Qiimale?
About.intro: Qiimale is a free, community-driven platform for reviewing the places and services people actually use across Somalia — restaurants, universities, companies, hospitals, schools, shops and online services. Read honest reviews before you choose, and share your own experience to help the next person.
About.why: Choosing a business or service in Somalia often means guessing. Qiimale exists to change that: real customer reviews build trust between buyers and sellers, reward businesses that do good work, and push everyone to keep improving.
About.howAdd: Browse by category or city, or submit a new place for the community to review.
About.howReview: Verified users write one review per place with a 1–5 star rating, photos and upvotes.
About.howTrust: Reviews go live instantly; community flagging and admin moderation keep them trustworthy.
About.cityIntro: Explore businesses and services in {city} — compare real reviews and ratings, and share your own experience to help others choose with confidence.
About.categoryIntro: Explore the best {category} in Somalia — compare real reviews and ratings, and share your own experience to help others choose with confidence.
